name: Machine-user identity: real Git push/fetch and gh API use synthetic bot while owner remains usable
GitHub App identity: signed JWT, repository-scoped cache refresh and denied-installation refusal on localhost
Identity guards reject insecure secrets, denied access, embedded remote credentials and owner netrc
Local notification API produces owner instructions and non-actionable outsider/edited notes across issue, PR and commit sources
Paged discovery retries HTTP failure without cursor loss; repeated notifications do not duplicate notes or reactions
Arm/check/disarm replaces unrelated stale PID and stops delayed owned poll without touching unrelated process
